async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process checks if the bot already possesses five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are required and verifies that enough raw iron is available. It then locates or places a furnace block nearby. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks, ensuring enough is present. Finally, it smelts the necessary raw iron into iron ingots using the selected fuel.
}
